title: Ball moved by the wind after a stroke
question: Your ball comes to rest after a stroke, but then the wind blows it somewhere else. According to the rules, how do you play on?

choices.text: Replace the ball to its original resting spot
Play the ball from its new position
Add a penalty and replace the ball
Replay your previous shot from the old spot

explanation: If the wind or gravity moves your ball after it has come to rest from a stroke, you must play it from its new position, with no penalty.
